Dana (CSM): Quick heads-up — Orion Health (acct: orion-health) triggered a scheduled reindex overnight and their embedding token count spiked. QBR Friday; need remediation + numbers.
Carlos (FinOps): How big is the spike vs usual? Baseline vs 24h delta?
Maya (SWE): Traces show `/embeds/upsert` causing the bulk. 24h delta +315k tokens; ~6 workers replaying chunks. SDK: go-sdk v0.8.7.
alert-bot: Alert: high-embed-usage for orion-health — 2026-06-03T01:12:11Z — delta +314800 tokens.
Dana (CSM): Can Ops put a soft throttle so their search won't break but prevents further runaway?
Ben (CS Ops): Yes. Propose org-level soft cap 300k tokens/day on `/embeds/upsert` for 48h with an infra bypass key. I'll stage the rule now.
Carlos (FinOps): Baseline embeddings avg = 105k/day. Current 7-day avg = 280k/day. Projected 30-day if unchanged ~8.4M tokens. If this consumes >30% of prepaid credits, flag renewal as at-risk.
Maya (SWE): Quick code suggestion to share in the workshop: add per-job idempotency + worker semaphore. Snippet:
```
resp := client.Embeds.Upsert(ctx, chunks, WithIdempotency(jobID))
if resp.Conflict() {
  // check job status, skip duplicate
}
```
Dana (CSM): Action items:
- Ben: apply soft cap + enable infra bypass (ETA 15m)
- Maya: PR + onboarding doc snippet with idempotency pattern (ETA 24h)
- Carlos: prepare credit remediation numbers + renewal risk note for QBR (ETA tomorrow)
- Dana: update QBR slide and customer-facing email (ETA EOD)
Ben (CS Ops): Soft cap applied for org orion-health on `/embeds/upsert` 300k tokens/day — active 2026-06-03T01:28:40Z.
Maya (SWE): I'll add telemetry to flag >2x chunk replays and add a short retry/backoff guidance.
Carlos (FinOps): Once the cap shows reduced usage, I'll compute avoided cost and suggest a modest credit offset for the reindex. Will include numbers in the QBR.
Dana (CSM): Scheduling a 30m enablement + 30m review with their infra team to walk fixes. Leaving thread open until deck and postmortem are in. Ping here for any new spikes.
